title: The Song Language of the Cave Punan | Santa Fe Institute
text: They travel in small multi-family groups along a network of caves, and atttribute their health and well being not only to their practice of sharing food, but also to the Song language they sing at night in the caves. The Song language is very distantly related to their normal spoken language; it is not known to neighboring resettled Punan communities; and appears to be an isolate equally distant from Austronesian and Austro-Asiatic language families.
